title: User Guide
intro: How to use Kounouz Alafiya, step by step, based on your role.

steps.title: Scan the QR code
steps.body: Scan the code printed on the product with your phone's camera, or type the code manually on the "Verify a product" page.

steps.title: Check the traceability
steps.body: See the honey's origin, the producer, the batch, and the lab results.

steps.title: Shop with confidence
steps.body: Browse the online store and add verified products to your cart.

steps.title: Create an account (optional)
steps.body: Create a customer account to keep track of your order history.

steps.title: Create your producer account
steps.body: Sign up with your apiary/farm name and location.

steps.title: Log in
steps.body: Access your producer dashboard to track your requests and products.

steps.title: Submit a verification request
steps.body: Describe your honey (type, quantity) to start the verification process.

steps.title: Track the status
steps.body: Follow progress: request received, sample collected, at the lab, verified.

steps.title: Product published
steps.body: Once the batch is verified, your product appears on the marketplace with its own QR code.

steps.title: Log in to your space
steps.body: Your dashboard lists today's tasks.

steps.title: Check collection requests
steps.body: See verification requests waiting for a sample to be collected.

steps.title: Visit the producer
steps.body: Collect the honey sample on site.

steps.title: Record the sample
steps.body: Enter the details (weight, photos) directly from the mobile app.

steps.title: Sent to the lab
steps.body: The recorded sample is automatically queued for lab analysis.

steps.title: Log in to the admin space
steps.body: Your dashboard gives an overview of current activity.

steps.title: Process requests
steps.body: Under "Traceability → Requests", accept or reject each verification request.

steps.title: Track samples and seals
steps.body: Make sure each collected sample is properly sealed before it's sent to the lab.

steps.title: Enter the lab result
steps.body: Under "Laboratory", record the analysis results you receive.

steps.title: Validate the verification
steps.body: Under "Verification", approve or reject the batch based on the results.

steps.title: Manage the catalog
steps.body: Once the batch is verified, manage its packaging, products, categories, and QR code under "Catalog".

steps.title: Steer the operation
steps.body: Check reports, manage the team, and handle support requests under "Steering".
